<!--
What it does: An interactive report on the African studies in the 2022 World
  Bank NbS extraction, cleaned for CC4A. Its centre is the per-paper time
  series: for every paper that reports an outcome (variable cost, gross
  margin ...) separately for two or more years, that paper's values over its
  years, in its own currency, one line per treatment arm.
Reads: data/wb_nbs_extraction_2022_cc4a.xlsx  (sheets extracted_cc4a, orig_Refs)
Writes: the rendered HTML, docs/reports/wb2022_explorer.html when built with
  R/00_prep/render_wb2022_explorer.R
Flags: none. Knit in RStudio, or run R/00_prep/render_wb2022_explorer.R.
-->

```{r setup, include = FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE,
                      fig.width = 10, fig.height = 5)
root <- rprojroot::find_root(rprojroot::has_file("CC4A.Rproj"))
source(file.path(root, "R/00_shared/paths.R"))
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(dplyr)
  library(tidyr)
  library(plotly)
  library(DT)
})

# A paper enters the time series for an outcome when it reports that outcome
# separately for at least this many distinct years. Values pooled over
# several years (a measurement year such as 2017.2018) are one value, not a
# series, and do not count.
MIN_YEARS_IN_SERIES <- 2

# The outcomes given a time-series tab, in this order.
SERIES_OUTCOMES <- c("Variable Cost", "Total Cost", "Labour Cost", "Gross Return",
                     "Gross Margin", "Net Return")

# Outcomes grouped for reading. Ratios and rates have no currency.
OUTCOME_GROUPS <- list(
  "Cost"   = c("Variable Cost", "Total Cost", "Total Cost (Unconfirmed)", "Labour Cost",
               "Variable Cost per Asset", "Variable Cost per Unit Product",
               "Total Cost per Asset", "Total Cost per Unit Product",
               "Labour Cost per Asset", "Labour Cost per Unit Product",
               "Present Value of Cost"),
  "Return" = c("Gross Return", "Net Return", "Net Return (Unconfirmed)", "Gross Margin",
               "Returns to Labour", "Return to Labour", "Present Value of Benefit")
)

# Cost item columns: yes/no flags for what a cost figure includes.
COST_ITEMS <- c("Seeds", "Nutrient Inputs", "Labour", "Pest Control Inputs", "Land (rent)",
                "Equipment Costs", "Tax", "Transport", "Irrigation")

PRACTICE_LABELS <- c(
  awd = "AWD (irrigated rice)", biochar = "Biochar", ca_bundle = "Reduced tillage / CA",
  dsr = "Direct-seeded rice", feed_mgmt = "Feed management",
  nutrient_mgmt_b = "Nutrient management / ISFM", rotational_grazing = "Rotational grazing",
  silvopasture = "Silvopasture", soil_cover = "Soil cover", sri = "SRI",
  trees_in_farmlands = "Trees in farmlands"
)
```

```{r data}
raw <- readxl::read_excel(FILE_WB2022_CC4A, sheet = "extracted_cc4a", col_types = "text")
refs <- readxl::read_excel(FILE_WB2022_CC4A, sheet = "orig_Refs", col_types = "text")
pub_year <- setNames(suppressWarnings(as.integer(refs$citation_pub_year)), refs$ID)

#' TRUE where any country named in the cell is in Africa ("Bangladesh/India/
#' Nepal" names three). Looked up once per distinct cell.
is_africa <- function(country) {
  cells <- unique(ifelse(is.na(country), "", country))
  hit <- vapply(strsplit(cells, "[/;,]"), function(p) {
    cont <- suppressWarnings(countrycode::countrycode(trimws(p), "country.name", "continent"))
    any(cont %in% "Africa", na.rm = TRUE)
  }, TRUE)
  unname(setNames(hit, cells)[ifelse(is.na(country), "", country)])
}

#' Years a measurement covers. The column mixes formats: 2017; lists such as
#' 2017.2018; seasons such as 2018.1 or 2018.2.2019.2; ranges such as
#' 2009-2019; and Excel damage such as 2016.2017000000001 or 2009.201
#' (2009.2010 with its trailing zero dropped).
parse_years <- function(s) {
  s <- trimws(s)
  if (is.na(s) || !grepl("(19|20)[0-9]{2}", s)) return(integer())
  if (grepl("^[0-9]{4} *- *[0-9]{4}$", s)) {
    r <- as.integer(strsplit(s, " *- *")[[1]])
    return(seq(min(r), max(r)))
  }
  if (grepl("^[0-9]{4}[.][0-9]{9,}$", s)) {
    second <- round(as.numeric(paste0("0.", substring(s, 6))) * 1e4)
    return(unique(c(as.integer(substr(s, 1, 4)), as.integer(second))))
  }
  if (grepl("^[0-9]{4}[.][0-9]{3}$", s)) {
    return(unique(c(as.integer(substr(s, 1, 4)), as.integer(paste0(substring(s, 6), "0")))))
  }
  tok <- strsplit(s, "[.;,/ ]+")[[1]]
  unique(as.integer(tok[grepl("^(19|20)[0-9]{2}$", tok)]))
}

#' Position on the time axis for a single-year measurement: the year, moved
#' along a third of a year per season where a season is given (2013.2 sits
#' at 2013.33), so two seasons in one year do not overlap.
time_point <- function(raw_year, year) {
  season <- ifelse(grepl("^[0-9]{4}[.][1-3]$", trimws(raw_year)),
                   as.integer(substring(trimws(raw_year), 6)), 1L)
  year + (season - 1) / 3
}

group_of <- function(outcome) {
  g <- rep("Ratio or rate", length(outcome))
  for (n in names(OUTCOME_GROUPS)) g[outcome %in% OUTCOME_GROUPS[[n]]] <- n
  g
}

years <- lapply(raw$Measurement_Year, parse_years)
all_rows <- raw |>
  mutate(years = years,
         n_years = lengths(years),
         region = ifelse(is_africa(Country), "Africa", "Rest of world"))

# Africa only, from here on.
obs <- all_rows |>
  filter(region == "Africa") |>
  mutate(
    year_first = vapply(years, function(y) if (length(y)) min(y) else NA_integer_, 1L),
    year_last  = vapply(years, function(y) if (length(y)) max(y) else NA_integer_, 1L),
    pub_year   = unname(pub_year[StudyID]),
    year_basis = ifelse(n_years > 0, "measurement year", "publication year (none recorded)"),
    year_first = ifelse(is.na(year_first), pub_year, year_first),
    t          = ifelse(n_years == 1, time_point(Measurement_Year, year_first), NA_real_),
    outcome_group = group_of(Outcome),
    unit       = trimws(Outcome_Unit),
    value_trt  = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(Value_Trt)),
    value_con  = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(Value_Con)),
    practice_labels = vapply(strsplit(cc4a_practices, "; "), function(p) {
      l <- PRACTICE_LABELS[p]; l[is.na(l)] <- p[is.na(l)]; paste(l, collapse = "; ")
    }, ""),
    short_title = paste0(substr(Title, 1, 80), ifelse(nchar(Title) > 80, "...", ""))
  )

long <- obs |>
  mutate(practice = strsplit(cc4a_practices, "; ")) |>
  unnest(practice) |>
  mutate(practice_label = coalesce(unname(PRACTICE_LABELS[practice]), practice))
```

## About this data

These are the **`r n_distinct(obs$StudyID)` African studies** (`r format(nrow(obs), big.mark = ",")` observations) in the 2022 World Bank NbS extraction that test at least one CC4A practice. The extraction covered all low and middle income countries; the other `r n_distinct(all_rows$StudyID[all_rows$region != "Africa"])` studies are outside Africa and are left out of everything below. Countries: `r paste(sort(unique(unlist(strsplit(obs$Country, "[/;,] *")))), collapse = ", ")`.

Three things to keep in mind.

- **Each paper reports in its own currency and prices.** Within one paper the currency is the same every year, so a paper's costs over its years form a valid series in that currency. Across papers they do not compare until converted to one currency and base year (Chun's step). Nothing here converts or pools currencies.
- **A series needs separate values per year.** Some papers report one value pooled over several years (a measurement year recorded as, say, 2017.2018). That is one number, not a series, and it is counted apart below.
- **Practices** come from the mapping in `catalogues/map_wb2022_practices.csv`. A row coded to two practices (biochar with fertiliser, say) carries both.

## Which papers report an outcome over several years

For each outcome: how many African papers report it, how many report it **separately for `r MIN_YEARS_IN_SERIES` or more years** (these are the papers in the time series below), how many for three or more, and how many give only values pooled over several years.

```{r series-coverage}
coverage <- obs |>
  filter(outcome_group != "Ratio or rate") |>
  group_by(Outcome, StudyID) |>
  summarise(separate_years = n_distinct(year_first[n_years == 1]),
            pooled_only = all(n_years >= 2),
            unit = paste(unique(unit), collapse = ", "),
            .groups = "drop") |>
  group_by(Outcome) |>
  summarise(papers = n(),
            papers_2plus_years = sum(separate_years >= 2),
            papers_3plus_years = sum(separate_years >= 3),
            papers_pooled_only = sum(pooled_only),
            currencies = paste(sort(unique(unlist(strsplit(unit, ", ")))), collapse = ", "),
            .groups = "drop") |>
  arrange(desc(papers_2plus_years), desc(papers))
datatable(coverage, rownames = FALSE,
          colnames = c("Outcome", "Papers", "Papers with 2+ separate years",
                       "Papers with 3+ separate years", "Papers with pooled multi-year values only",
                       "Units reported"),
          options = list(pageLength = 15, dom = "tp", scrollX = TRUE))
```

## Per-paper time series

One chart per paper. Each line is a treatment arm, in the paper's own currency and unit: practice arms solid, the control dashed. Hover for the exact value, the year as recorded, the site and the practice. Click a legend entry to hide or show an arm. The y-axis of each chart is that paper's own; do not compare heights between charts.

```{r series-data}
# The values of every arm at every single-year time point. Each extracted row
# carries the practice arm and its control; the control is de-duplicated
# because several practice rows share it.
points <- obs |>
  filter(n_years == 1, !is.na(t), Outcome %in% SERIES_OUTCOMES) |>
  mutate(where = trimws(paste(coalesce(Site_Name, ""), coalesce(Product, ""), sep = " | ")))
# The 2022 extraction stores practice-control pairs, so a practice arm compared
# with three controls appears three times with the same value: kept once.
practice_pts <- points |>
  filter(!is.na(value_trt)) |>
  transmute(StudyID, Outcome, unit, where, t, Measurement_Year, arm = Treatment_Name,
            role = "Practice", value = value_trt, practice_labels) |>
  distinct(StudyID, Outcome, unit, where, t, arm, value, .keep_all = TRUE)
control_pts <- points |>
  filter(!is.na(value_con)) |>
  transmute(StudyID, Outcome, unit, where, t, Measurement_Year, arm = Control_Name,
            role = "Control", value = value_con, practice_labels = "Control") |>
  distinct(StudyID, Outcome, unit, where, t, arm, value, .keep_all = TRUE)

series <- bind_rows(practice_pts, control_pts) |>
  group_by(StudyID, Outcome, unit) |>
  filter(n_distinct(floor(t)) >= MIN_YEARS_IN_SERIES) |>
  ungroup() |>
  mutate(line = paste(role, arm, where, sep = " :: "),
         arm_label = ifelse(where %in% c("|", ""), arm, paste0(arm, " (", where, ")"))) |>
  left_join(distinct(obs, StudyID, short_title, Title, Country, DOI), by = "StudyID") |>
  arrange(StudyID, line, t)

#' One plotly chart for one paper and outcome.
paper_plot <- function(d) {
  head <- d[1, ]
  p <- plot_ly()
  for (ln in unique(d$line)) {
    x <- d[d$line == ln, ]
    p <- add_trace(p, data = x, x = ~t, y = ~value, type = "scatter", mode = "lines+markers",
                   name = x$arm_label[1], legendgroup = x$role[1],
                   line = list(dash = if (x$role[1] == "Control") "dash" else "solid",
                               width = if (x$role[1] == "Control") 3 else 2),
                   text = ~paste0("<b>", arm_label, "</b> (", role, ")<br>",
                                  Outcome, ": ", format(value, big.mark = ","), " ", unit,
                                  "<br>Year as recorded: ", Measurement_Year,
                                  "<br>", practice_labels),
                   hoverinfo = "text")
  }
  layout(p,
         title = list(text = paste0("<b>", head$short_title, "</b><br><sup>", head$Country,
                                    " | StudyID ", head$StudyID, " | ", head$Outcome, " in ",
                                    head$unit, "</sup>"), x = 0, font = list(size = 13)),
         xaxis = list(title = "Year (seasons shown as thirds of a year)", dtick = 1),
         yaxis = list(title = head$unit, rangemode = "tozero"),
         legend = list(orientation = "h", y = -0.3, font = list(size = 10)),
         margin = list(t = 70))
}

#' The charts for one outcome, one per paper, or a note when there are none.
outcome_plots <- function(outcome) {
  d <- series[series$Outcome == outcome, ]
  if (!nrow(d)) {
    return(htmltools::p(htmltools::em(paste0(
      "No African paper reports ", tolower(outcome), " separately for ",
      MIN_YEARS_IN_SERIES, " or more years."))))
  }
  keys <- unique(d[, c("StudyID", "unit")])
  htmltools::tagList(lapply(seq_len(nrow(keys)), function(i) {
    paper_plot(d[d$StudyID == keys$StudyID[i] & d$unit == keys$unit[i], ])
  }))
}

#' All of an outcome's lines on one chart, each set to 100 at its first time
#' point, so papers in different currencies can be compared for direction and
#' pace of change. Only lines with a non-zero first value can be indexed.
index_plot <- function(outcome) {
  d <- series[series$Outcome == outcome, ] |>
    group_by(StudyID, line) |>
    arrange(t, .by_group = TRUE) |>
    filter(first(value) != 0, n() >= 2) |>
    mutate(index = 100 * value / first(value)) |>
    ungroup()
  if (!nrow(d)) return(NULL)
  plot_ly(d, x = ~t, y = ~index, color = ~paste0(Country, " (", StudyID, ")"),
          split = ~line, type = "scatter", mode = "lines+markers",
          linetype = ~role, linetypes = c(Control = "dash", Practice = "solid"),
          text = ~paste0("<b>", short_title, "</b><br>", arm_label, " (", role, ")",
                         "<br>Index ", round(index), " (", format(value, big.mark = ","), " ", unit, ")",
                         "<br>Year as recorded: ", Measurement_Year),
          hoverinfo = "text", showlegend = FALSE) |>
    layout(title = list(text = paste0("<b>", outcome, ", all papers indexed to their first year = 100</b>"),
                        x = 0, font = list(size = 13)),
           xaxis = list(title = "Year", dtick = 1),
           yaxis = list(title = "Index (first year = 100)"),
           shapes = list(list(type = "line", xref = "paper", x0 = 0, x1 = 1, y0 = 100, y1 = 100,
                              line = list(color = "grey", dash = "dot"))))
}
```

Each tab says how many papers it holds. The **index chart** under the paper charts puts every line of that outcome on one axis, each set to 100 in its own first year. It shows direction and pace of change across papers without converting currency.

## Coverage at a glance

Studies per practice and outcome, African studies only.

```{r coverage}
cov <- long |>
  filter(outcome_group != "Ratio or rate") |>
  group_by(practice_label, Outcome) |>
  summarise(studies = n_distinct(StudyID), .groups = "drop")
outs <- long |> filter(outcome_group != "Ratio or rate") |> count(Outcome, sort = TRUE) |>
  slice_head(n = 12) |> pull(Outcome)
cov <- cov |> filter(Outcome %in% outs) |>
  complete(practice_label, Outcome = outs, fill = list(studies = 0))
plot_ly(cov, x = ~Outcome, y = ~practice_label, z = ~studies, type = "heatmap",
        colors = c("#f7fbff", "#08306b"),
        text = ~paste0(practice_label, "<br>", Outcome, "<br>", studies, " studies"),
        hoverinfo = "text") |>
  add_annotations(x = ~Outcome, y = ~practice_label, text = ~ifelse(studies > 0, studies, ""),
                  showarrow = FALSE, font = list(size = 10)) |>
  layout(xaxis = list(title = "", tickangle = -40), yaxis = list(title = ""),
         margin = list(b = 140, l = 180))
```

## Where the studies are

```{r map}
by_country <- obs |>
  mutate(country = strsplit(Country, "[/;,] *")) |>
  unnest(country) |>
  mutate(country = trimws(country)) |>
  group_by(country) |>
  summarise(studies = n_distinct(StudyID), observations = n(), .groups = "drop")
plot_ly(by_country, type = "choropleth", locations = ~country, locationmode = "country names",
        z = ~studies, colorscale = "Blues",
        text = ~paste0(country, ": ", studies, " studies, ", observations, " observations"),
        hoverinfo = "text") |>
  layout(geo = list(scope = "africa", showframe = FALSE))
```

## What the cost figures include

For cost outcomes: the share of observations whose cost figure includes each item, as the extractors recorded it. A cost that leaves out labour or land is not comparable with one that includes them.

```{r cost-items}
cost_rows <- obs |> filter(outcome_group == "Cost")
items <- cost_rows |>
  select(StudyID, all_of(COST_ITEMS)) |>
  pivot_longer(all_of(COST_ITEMS), names_to = "item", values_to = "included") |>
  mutate(included = case_when(grepl("^\\(?yes", included, ignore.case = TRUE) ~ "Included",
                              grepl("^no", included, ignore.case = TRUE) ~ "Not included",
                              TRUE ~ "Not recorded")) |>
  count(item, included) |>
  group_by(item) |> mutate(share = n / sum(n)) |> ungroup()
plot_ly(items, y = ~item, x = ~share, color = ~included, type = "bar", orientation = "h",
        colors = c("Included" = "#2c7fb8", "Not included" = "#fdae61", "Not recorded" = "#d9d9d9"),
        text = ~paste0(item, ": ", included, ", ", n, " observations (", round(100 * share), "%)"),
        hoverinfo = "text") |>
  layout(barmode = "stack", title = paste0("Cost items included (", nrow(cost_rows), " African cost observations)"),
         xaxis = list(title = "Share of cost observations", tickformat = ".0%"),
         yaxis = list(title = ""), legend = list(orientation = "h", y = -0.2))
```

## Data explorer

Every African observation. Filter any column, search across them all, and download what you see.

```{r explorer}
explorer <- obs |>
  transmute(StudyID, Title, Country, Practices = practice_labels, Fit = cc4a_fit,
            Site = Site_Name, Product, Treatment = Treatment_Name, Control = Control_Name,
            Outcome, Unit = unit, `Value (practice)` = value_trt, `Value (control)` = value_con,
            `Measurement_Year (raw)` = Measurement_Year, `Years covered` = n_years,
            `First year` = year_first, `Year source` = year_basis,
            `Discount rate` = Discount_Rate, Location = Value_Loc, DOI, Extractor = extractor)
datatable(explorer, rownames = FALSE, filter = "top", extensions = "Buttons",
          options = list(pageLength = 15, scrollX = TRUE, dom = "Bfrtip",
                         buttons = c("copy", "csv", "excel")))
```
